summary: 16 changes, 68 tasks, all valid under openspec --strict, covering all ELEVEN items (S1-S6 seeded + R1-R5 added). Ordered in-repo-cheap-first (wave 1: cursor, CI, FFI cost, librefang decision), then UAR provenance (wave 2 — blocks R5 because nothing currently records which pack version is loaded), then skill lifecycle (wave 3), then execution proof and mobile (wave 4).
warnings: All UAR claims are CROSS-REPO and unverifiable from this repo's review packet. Each change must re-run its own reproduction command before acting — none may proceed on a claim inherited from plan.md.
change-uhe-006 begins with a PROBE: if a DB constraint can target definition->>'origin', it delivers that and adds no columns. Either branch COMPLETES so downstream dependencies never dangle.
change-uhe-015 is the parity gate. Nothing may be reported as end-to-end parity until it passes.
change-uhe-016 delivers a report plus an in-repo CHECK, not a patch — the kbd-reflect/kbd-next-phase fixes live in installed skills where edits die at the next install.
R1 requires all THREE persistence providers (postgres, surreal, memory). memory IS the embedded case and must not be skipped.
